reasons.plausibility: Chemical heterogeneity at surfaces affecting premelting is scientifically plausible and supported by known effects of compositional disorder in HEA systems, though other factors could also play a role.
reasons.testability: They propose a well-defined comparison (annealed vs. unannealed nanoparticles) and specific measurements (DSC, in situ TEM) with a clear criterion for falsification.
reasons.usefulness: Identifying and controlling surface heterogeneity to modulate premelting temperature is directly relevant to improving thermal stability of HEA nanoparticles, making the hypothesis valuable to test.
